entities.text: J. Bhadru vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of the respondents in trying to lay the roads in the petitioners' agricultural patta land in Sy.No.266 E/2, Sy.No.265/A, 266/E, Sy.No.265/A/2/1,
266/E/1 Sy.No.265/A/2, 265/E/3 situated at Dharma Thanda, Kusumanchi Panchayat and Mandal,
Khammam District, Telangana State without following due process of law as illegal and arbitrary.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development.
3.

This Court granted interim order in W.P.M.P.No.20030 of 2017 in W.P.No.16308 of 2017 dated 27.04.2017 directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners over the subject lands without following due process of law.

However, in spite of lapse of more than 7 years,
the SK, J respondents did not choose to file counter or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioners.
4. In view of the same, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners over the subject lands without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the lands of the petitioners, they have to follow due process under the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
